heading: Beyond the orrery
lead: Each orrery stands complete on its own. These additions extend it: into touch, into light and knowledge, and out into the open air. Choose any combination; each is made to suit your piece.

controller.name: Planetary Controller
controller.body: A touch interface for interacting with your orrery. Play planetary motion scenes, align the planets to any date in history or the future, and set the colour and brightness of each world.
features: Align the planets to a specific date
Colour and brightness of each planet

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.tagline: A layer of knowledge over the real sky.
aurora.body: Aurora is an interactive augmented-reality layer for the orrery. It adds digital information over the moving planets: their orbits, their names, other celestial objects and educational stories about each one.

dome.name: Galaxy Dome
dome.body: An LED-lined dome that sits above the orrery and runs mesmerising patterns of light. Add pre-programmed tracks from our music library and the dome moves in time with the music.
features: Hung from the ceiling, or raised on free-standing columns as an indoor gazebo
Music-synced tracks from our library, available to purchase

pavilion.name: Celestial Pavilion
pavilion.tagline: A home for your orrery under the open sky.
pavilion.body: For outdoor installations, a gazebo-like structure that keeps the orrery safe from the elements. Its dome, columns and proportions are designed around your piece and your setting.
features: Protects the orrery outdoors, in every season
Dome size, columns and details customised
Compatible with every other add-on, together or apart

compatibility: Every add-on works with every orrery, and with each other. Aurora needs the Planetary Controller to run.

closing.heading: Choose what speaks to you.
closing.text: Try any combination in the builder, then send it to us as the start of a conversation.
